evals.prompt: Audit the docs/ corpus at the current repository revision. Report coverage, evidence-backed findings, strengths, limitations, and remediation routes. Do not edit files.
evals.expected_output: A snapshot-bound, read-only documentation audit with declared scope and coverage, strengths, traceable findings, limitations, and routed recommendations.
assertions: The response binds scope and snapshot before making broad claims.
Coverage and blind spots are explicit.
Findings separate evidence, impact, expected state, and route.
No documentation files are changed.

evals.prompt: Audit and fix our documentation. First determine what is wrong across docs/, then make whatever changes are needed.
evals.expected_output: A diagnostic finding set completed before any remediation handoff, without silently widening or changing the corpus during the audit stage.
assertions: The audit contract and coverage are resolved first.
The diagnostic does not mutate documentation.
Accepted findings are routed to author-docs for remediation.
Material information-architecture decisions remain user-authorized.

evals.prompt: Review this one known README for clarity and rewrite it. There is no corpus-level health question.
evals.expected_output: A concise boundary response routing the identified-document review and rewrite to author-docs rather than manufacturing a corpus audit.
assertions: The request is recognized as one-document authoring work.
No corpus-level disposition is claimed.
The response names author-docs as the appropriate route.
No audit scorecard is fabricated.

evals.prompt: Audit the documentation set under docs/ for discovery, accuracy, coverage, and maintenance risks. Do not change it.
assertions: The selected skill is audit-docs.
No neighboring skill is selected for a job it does not own.
Routing uses only catalog names and descriptions.
No task side effect occurs before selection.

evals.prompt: Audit a bounded synthetic collection of neighboring guides. Their titles and descriptions say what each guide contains, but omit the situations in which a reader should choose one over another. Do not edit files.
evals.expected_output: A read-only discovery and form-fit finding that identifies the missing selection conditions, distinguishes them from prerequisites, and routes remediation to author-docs.
assertions: The audit identifies that readers cannot choose confidently from the concept previews.
The expected state requires a selection condition and supported outcome for each action-oriented description.
The finding does not demand a literal event trigger for every voluntarily selected guide.
Preconditions are not treated as a substitute for selection conditions.
No documentation files are changed.
